a thief whose adjustments left the skill at nothing rolling anyway

	return DisarmResult::BEYOND_SKILL;

a successful removal leaving the trap armed
a save that forgets the attempt, handing it back on reload - the save-scum this closed
a load that drops the attempt, which reads as a fresh trap to the same thief
every trap hidden again on load, so a level the player has cleared is unknown
